prompts.environment:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game environment sprite atlas for Invisible Castle.
Images 1 and 2 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Regenerate the art from scratch, never crop, trace out, or reuse pixels from either reference.
Match the reference's polished crisp 16-bit RPG pixel art: blue slate shadows, highlighted edges, richly shaded golden brown timber, warm candle flames, near-front top-down orthographic view (see tops and front faces), dark 1-2 pixel outlines, restrained pixel clusters, no blurry painting.
Create ONE transparent PNG sprite atlas, EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, 1024x1024 canvas, every cell 256x256. No text, labels, dividers, background, checkerboard or ground tiles. Every object fully visible and centered in its own cell with 20 pixels safe transparent margin. Large chunky pixels as though each cell were 64x64 enlarged nearest-neighbor 4x.
Objects ordered left-to-right top-to-bottom:
Row 1: single wooden bed with white pillow and blue blanket; tall two-door wooden locked cupboard with brass latch; low wooden treasure chest with iron bands; ornate wide wooden warden desk with parchment map, small stack of books, lit candle.
Row 2: wide tool bench with screwdriver and hammer; wide crafting workbench with coiled rope and iron hook; upright wooden barrel with metal hoops; upright double-height small bookshelf filled with bright red blue gold green book spines.
Row 3: laundry wicker basket piled with folded cream linens; wide stone-framed dark drainage opening with silver vertical grate; wide common-room wooden table with map, books and candle; tall iron barred medieval door with brass lock.
Row 4: leafy green plant in terracotta pot; silver knight armor statue on stone pedestal with blue and gold heraldic plaque; hanging royal blue banner with gold fleur-de-lis; paired stack of wooden crates with diagonal braces.
Keep all 16 cells independent, do not join adjacent sprites. Match reference object design closely. No characters. Transparent alpha background.
